# Abinesh U — AI Engineer

> Portfolio, systems architecture notes, and multi-agent orchestration projects by Abinesh U.

This website serves as the primary portfolio and technical publication platform for Abinesh U, an AI Engineer specializing in agentic systems, multi-agent coordination frameworks, and production AI infrastructure.

## Core Navigation

- [Home](https://abinesh.blog/): Core overview of systems, projects, and latest publications.
- [About](https://abinesh.blog/about): Detailed professional background, target AI engineering skill stack, and entities.
- [Systems](https://abinesh.blog/systems): Deep-dives into AI systems architecture, agent runtimes, and memory schemas.
- [Projects](https://abinesh.blog/projects): Engineering case studies and production code repositories for Hermes, Athena, and Aegis.
- [Blog](https://abinesh.blog/blog): Long-form documentation-style technical notes on agent execution patterns and tradeoffs.
- [Contact](https://abinesh.blog/contact): Workstation links, communication protocols, and collaboration channels.

## Key Projects

- [Hermes](https://abinesh.blog/projects#hermes): Research & multi-agent orchestrator utilizing LangGraph, FastAPI, Redis, and Qdrant.
- [Athena](https://abinesh.blog/projects#athena): Knowledge intelligence platform with FastAPI, Qdrant, PostgreSQL, and OpenAI.
- [Aegis](https://abinesh.blog/projects#aegis): Evaluation & security framework for testing LLM behavior in production environments.

## Core Systems & Frameworks

- [Multi-Agent Orchestration](https://abinesh.blog/systems#orchestration): Patterns for building autonomous agent teams with state recovery.
- [Agent Memory Architectures](https://abinesh.blog/systems#memory): Implementing persistent recall layers and semantic vector databases.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://abinesh.blog/systems#mcp): Designing secure tool gateways and execution runtimes.
- [Production Evals](https://abinesh.blog/systems#evals): Standardizing assertion frameworks and metrics for regression testing.

## Published Articles

- [Loop Engineering](https://abinesh.blog/blog/loop-engineering): Designing repeatable agent workflows with bounded handoffs, evidence, state, verification, and terminal states.
- [Harness Engineering](https://abinesh.blog/blog/harness-engineering): The missing reliability layer in agentic AI systems — deterministic execution boundaries.
- [The Shape of Agentic Systems](https://abinesh.blog/blog/the-shape-of-agentic-systems): A taxonomy of loops, hierarchies and graphs that work in production.
- [Memory Is the System](https://abinesh.blog/blog/memory-is-the-system): Working, episodic, semantic and procedural memory in practice.
- [RAG Is a Retrieval Problem](https://abinesh.blog/blog/rag-is-a-retrieval-problem): Why most RAG systems plateau and the retrieval-side investments that move quality.
- [Evals as Product Engineering](https://abinesh.blog/blog/evals-as-product-engineering): Treating evaluation as a first-class system with datasets, judges, traces and regressions.
